title: The Unretreating Vow to Be Born in the Pure Land
excerpt: That Buddha and his people have a lifespan of immeasurable, boundless asamkhyeya kalpas.

inline.s: Buddha and his people have a lifespan of immeasurable, boundless asamkhyeya kalpas.
The living beings in that land are free from all manner of suffering and enjoy only happiness.
All beings born in that land are avaivartika — never falling back
They attain the company of such assemblies of excellent and virtuous beings, gathered together in one place.
Though body and mind may grow ever so weary, the vow to seek the Pure Land stands firm and steady.
